versions.title: The generalized Lax conjecture holds for mixed determinants
versions.abstract: We prove that the mixed determinant $\eta(\cdot)$ of Borcea and Brändén has a spectrahedral hyperbolicity cone. More precisely, for Hermitian matrices $A_1,\ldots,A_m$ of order $d$, the hyperbolicity cone of $\eta(A_1,\ldots,A_m)$ is cut out by $\sum_j\Phi_j(A_j)\succeq0$, where $\Phi_1,\ldots,\Phi_m$ are explicit unital completely positive maps. We argue by induction on $d$, adding one row and one column to every argument and expressing the logarithmic derivatives of $\eta$ as extremal eigenvalues. By compressing along polynomial boundary kernels, we reduce the order of the pencil $\sum_j\Phi_j(A_j)$ to $\exp(O(md^3\log m))$; for one fixed positive semidefinite $n\times n$ matrix $A$ a separate pencil yields the order $\exp(O(n^2\log n))$. We also answer four problems of Borcea and Brändén negatively.
